answer_1.quote: Our benchmark includes a total of 15 ocean-related tasks such as question-answering, extraction, and description.
answer_1.outputs: generated text outputs for ocean science tasks

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation. To evaluate the performance and reduce reliance on manual evaluation, we leverage GPT-4 as the evaluator.

answer_3.quote: For each testing question, we query the GPT4 to obtain the comparison result when given two outputs from two LLMs.

answer_4.quote: We employ 5 students with an ocean science background as human annotators. For each evaluation setting, we sample a set of 200 examples and human annotators will rank the outputs they prefer.
